title: Animate Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit

summary:
Retrofitted 🎞️animate from V1 to Shape V2 tree purity, purely mechanical, zero logic changes. (1) Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs; updated [lib] path to "📦️lib.rs"; prefixed all non-"." #[path] strings with ../../. (2) Folded sibling variant files: 🎛️apps/🎬️present/🦀️config.rs → 🎚️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs → 🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs → 🌉️wasm/🦀️component.rs (internal #![cfg(target_arch="wasm32")] preserved verbatim); 🗿️artifacts/🎬️present/⚙️engine/🦀️animate_core.rs → 🎬️core/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️animate_video.rs → 🎥️video/🦀️component.rs. (3) Data (📚️examples, AGENTS.md) already at owner root, confirmed. (4) Verified with a temporary isolated-workspace overlay on the crate's own Cargo.toml, synchronously, after root cargo metadata was confirmed still blocked (a DIFFERENT in-flight plugin, 📸️remodel, has a dangling manifest member now that 📕️norm itself is fixed — not this retrofit's doing): cargo check clean (0 warnings for semio-s-plugin-animate, only pre-existing dependency-crate warnings), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test 208/208 passing (exact match of the pre-retrofit baseline). Overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock removed. Byte-identity of all 5 folded files vs git HEAD confirmed via diff. Tree purity confirmed: no non-component/non-packages *.rs files remain; top level is only 🎛️apps, 📚️examples, 🗿️artifacts, AGENTS.md, 📦️packages.

OUT-OF-SCOPE ITEM FLAGGED (not touched): 🎛️apps/🎬️present/📺️renderer/⚛️react/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/ is a leftover TS-only renderer still in the pre-taxonomy ⚡️implementations shape (never migrated at all, Rust-only crate consolidation left it alone per the original migration ticket). This belongs to the master ticket's W6 "residual mop-up for already-migrated plugins' leftover TS packages" — flagging for that wave, not touched here.

Registrar handoff: none needed — [lib] path is internal to the crate's own Cargo.toml, root Cargo.toml's member line is unchanged. No external references to the old owner-root 🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️lib.rs path found.
